verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own debit card issuance: a card-order API to create cards, kiosk-based physical card printing, and per-card spending permissions. However, the evidence frames this as Wise Platform partners issuing cards to their customers, not a business finance lead issuing cards to its employees. Missing for 10: employee card issuance from a Wise Business account, role-based cardholder permissions, credit card support, explicit physical card ordering and delivery for staff, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles

citations.quote: With this set of APIs, you will be able to create cards for your customers.
These APIs are designed to allow you to print and encrypt your card directly from a kiosk machine.
Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
